verses.he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.en: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; In the midst of the judges He judgeth:
'How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
Judge the poor and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
Rescue the poor and needy; Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.he: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ׀ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל־מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They know not, neither do they understand; They go about in darkness; All the foundations of the earth are moved.

verses.he: אֲ‍ֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.en: I said: Ye are godlike beings, And all of you sons of the Most High.

verses.he: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.'

verses.he: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For Thou shalt possess all the nations.
